message:
You must operate in one of two modes: consolidate generated candidates or refine a candidate blueprint.

Use the inlined SEARCH_SPACE_SUMMARY from the system message as your authoritative technical context.

MODE:
{{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.mode }}

CANDIDATE_INPUT: In Input field

If mode=generate, treat CANDIDATE_INPUT as explored candidates in workflow order and rank/select or synthesize a constrained hybrid.
If mode=refine, treat CANDIDATE_INPUT as the candidate to be refined and return one improved blueprint using constrained edits only.

Do not build a full model JSON. Do not validate. Do not call any tool.

Return exactly one JSON object with the following top-level fields:

{
  "selected_candidate": {
    "selection_mode": "selected|synthesized",
    "source_candidate_ids": [""],
    "model_family": "",
    "decision_rationale": "",
    "blueprint": {
      "backbone": "",
      "block_pattern": [""],
      "connectivity": "",
      "normalization": "",
      "regularization": "",
      "required_spec_elements": [""],
      "forbidden_or_avoided_elements": [""]
    },
    "scores": {
      "design_space_fit": 0,
      "architectural_plausibility": 0,
      "taxonomy_likelihood": 0,
      "cost_efficiency": 0,
      "overall": 0
    },
    "uncertainty_notes": [""]
  }
}

You must not output anything other than the final JSON object described above.
